_comment: CLUSTER 1a -- THE LOOP RUNS AND THE DRAW ENGINE NEVER FIRES, so the wish is never found.
The button is offered by rule WISH-DRAW -- whose whole premise is 'draw repeatedly through
infinite mana until you find the Living Wish' -- and the plan promises 31 blinks. The apply
runs all 31 blinks and emits THIRTY-ONE events, every one of them a blink:
31 x  hist [ability] Eldrazi Displacer: blinked Peregrine Drake (returns tapped)
Not one draw, not one Investigate, no wish, no finisher, opponent on 20 with 12 cards left.
[finish] confirms it from the other end: `none-found=62` -- ComboFinishFromHand was called
sixty-two times and never had a candidate, because the Living Wish was still in the library
the loop was supposed to dig through.
This is the seed-6 shape the user reported ('the loop drew 13 cards and stopped although
Living Wish was still in the library') at its purest -- here it draws ZERO. The sweep shows
it is not one board: every synthetic wish-from-library state fails, and it is the single
ONE CARD AWAY, sweep_2 shows the adjacent failure: add a second Conservatory and the loop
stops running at all (0 blinks, 0 events). Same trigger -- ApplyBlinkLoop's
EXPECTED TO FAIL until the fix lands. Kept out of test/combo_off/ so combo_off_check.sh's
